title: skills.yml
description: Toggle individual skills (built-in or user-added) and override their severity.

enabled.description: Skills explicitly enabled. If empty, all auto-discovered skills run. Listing a skill here makes the loader log a warning if the file is missing.

disabled.description: Skill names to skip even if loaded. Cannot disable a built-in L1 validator (C1-C5); use severity_overrides instead.

severity_overrides.description: Per-skill severity override. Keys are skill names, values are 'P0'/'P1'/'P2'/'P3'.
